title: Joe Brady: I made sure to let Keon Coleman know he'll be a part of our offense

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Joe Brady: I made sure to let Keon Coleman know he'll be a part of our offense
sources.description: Receiver Keon Coleman unwittingly became a lightning rod for Bills coverage when team owner Terry Pegula mentioned him during the press conference after firing former head coach Sean McDermott in January.
